_readme: Every visible string in the preview harness and the README screenshot comes from this file.
Replace the text with whatever you want shown publicly, then re-run:
Keep the '_shows' notes in mind — each row is in the shot to demonstrate something.
Room at 300px pane width: title ~40 chars before it ellipsizes, subtitle ~48.
'_shows' and '_readme' are ignored by both builders. Everything else is rendered.
Row order in the shot is by ageMinutes ascending. build-screenshot.mjs hovers rows by
index, so moving rows 1 or 3 changes which row the hover panes demonstrate.
A 720px pane holds about 9 rows plus 6 group headings. Past that the grouped pane loses its archived section off the bottom.

sessions._shows: active + unread + generated subtitle. the brightest row in the shot.
